title: Kunle Olukotun (Wikipedia)
notes: Wikipedia. Oyekunle Ayinde 'Kunle' Olukotun: British-born Yoruba Nigerian computer scientist; Stanford Cadence Design Systems Professor; 'father of the multi-core processor'; Stanford Hydra CMP leader. In 2017 Olukotun and Chris Ré founded SambaNova Systems. IEEE/ACM Fellow, NAE member (2021). Corroborated by Stanford official profile + Crunchbase News (163).
